entries.content_plain: CHAPTER 20 Pr 20:1-30 . 1. mocker-- scorner. Such men are made by wine. strong drink-- made by spicing wine (compare Is 5:11 , 22 ); and it may include wine. raging-- or boisterous as a drunkard. deceived-- literally, "erring," or reeling.
